parts.label: Part 3
parts.article:
Right then. Are we ready, Bob? Helen?

Yeah.

And is someone taking notes for John? He's at a tutorial, isn't he?

Yeah, I'll let him know what we agree.

Okay. Well, first thing is, has anyone apart from me actually been in a study syndicate before?

No. What does it actually involve, Andy?

Well, the idea is that it's a way for us for students to study together without a teacher.

Oh, yeah. Right.

When I did it last time, I found it helpful because, well, as I said, there's no teacher, so it means we're teaching one another. And I found I really learnt a lot through having to teach it myself. It seemed a very good way to learn.

And presumably it gives us the chance to share ideas as well.

And you get full of notes if you're all doing the reading.

That's right. And as well as that, because of that really, you can do, you know, much deeper research. So I thought we could try it to revise what we've done on the geology course. Because I know this is the one that most of us are worried about, the geology exam.

Oh, yes.

So the idea is we all look at a different topic, a different topic from the geology course, and then give a presentation and talk about it.

That's right. I've drawn up the framework of a table which might be useful.

Yeah, I've made a copy.

Oh, thanks.

For the first topic, I thought we could maybe do mountain building. Is that all right?

Yeah, sure. Actually, would you mind if I did that? I'm quite interested in it.

Right. So is May 9th, okay for that?

Yeah.

I'll just write that down, and it's Bob for Mountain Building. And the following week, it can't be May 16th because of our tutorial. But what about the 17th?

Hmm. Okay.

And what about the next topic? What would be the next priority?

Well, there's glaciated areas, but I don't want to do that.

Fair enough. Actually, I don't mind having a bash. I did an assignment on them. Glaciated areas, Andy. Then we need someone to do rock formation, Helen.

Yeah, okay. And John said he'd like to too, so you can put us both down for that.

When?

May 23rd would be best. Rock formation, Helen, and John, right. That really only leaves one week before the exams. Shall we make it on the 30th?

I can't make it, I'm afraid.

29th of May, the exams on June 3rd.

Have to be.

Okay. Any ideas for a topic?

John said he wouldn't mind doing something on volcanoes.

Great. That's everyone then.

And how long should these presentations be?

Well, it's obviously up to us. In my experience, 30 minutes is about enough.

Hmm, maybe a bit short. I'd have thought 40 minutes would be more like it.

Well, should we say 30 to 40 minutes?

Okay. And presumably time for questions and discussion.

Yes, together they usually take about 20 minutes. Where should we get the information from?

Is it mainly lecture notes?

Well, actually I suggest we avoid those because we already have all that information. I think it's better to go more deeply. We could use the bibliography. And anything else we find in the library, any other books. Hmm.

And articles, you know, from the journals. And then of course, there's lots of stuff on the internet.

Yes, that's the sort of thing. And what about the presentations? Will we just be talking? But presumably we can't use slides.

It'd be a bit difficult, but we can use the OHP. And the white board, of course.

And we can make photocopies of our notes so everyone can have a copy.

Yes, great. So is there anything else?

analyses.content: Bob 补充说，除了互相教学，学习小组还给他们提供了 share ideas（分享观点）的机会。
And presumably it gives us the chance to share ideas as well.
听到 "chance to" 后要紧跟动词短语，不要只填 ideas，动词 share 是核心动作。
And as well as that, because of that really, you can do, you know, much deeper research.
不要填 "revise"（复习），那是他们组织这个小组的目的，而不是具体能做的事情。
Andy 指出，因为大家分担了阅读任务，所以每个人可以做 deeper research（更深入的研究）。

analyses.content: For the first topic, I thought we could maybe do mountain building. Is that all right?
不要填 "Geology"，那是整个课程的名称，题目问的是具体的 Topic。
Andy 提议第一个话题可以做 mountain building（造山运动），Bob 表示有兴趣并接下了这个任务。
And the following week, it can't be May 16th because of our tutorial. (24) But what about the 17th?
典型的“否定干扰”，先听到 16th May，但后面紧跟 "can't be... because..."，要在转折词 But 后面抓取正确日期。
关于下周的时间，因为16号有辅导课不行，Andy 提议改成 17th（17号），大家同意了。
Shall we make it on the 30th? I can't make it, I'm afraid. 29th of May, the exams on June 3rd.
不要填 "30th"（被否决了）或 "June 3rd"（那是考试日期），注意听最终达成一致的日子。
原本提议30号，但有人去不了，于是改到了 29th of May（5月29号），就在6月3号考试前。

analyses.content: Andy 觉得30分钟够了，Bob 觉得40分钟更好，于是 Andy 折中提议 30 to 40 minutes。
Well, should we say 30 to 40 minutes?
不要只写一个数字，题目需要的是一个时间范围，要把两个数字都写上。
Okay. And presumably time for questions and discussion. Yes, together they usually take about 20 minutes.
不要填 "20 minutes"，那是这两个环节通常花费的时长，不是环节本身的名称。
除了演讲时间，Bob 补充说还应该预留时间给 questions and discussion（提问和讨论）。
And articles, you know, from the journals.
题目是并列关系（Bibliography, Library books...），听到 "And..." 后面的名词即为答案，注意复数 s。
关于资料来源，Andy 建议除了书，还可以使用期刊里的 articles（文章）。
And then of course, there's lots of stuff on the internet.
不要填 "stuff"，那是口语化的表达，学术场景填空要用具体的名词 internet。
Andy 接着补充说，当然 internet（互联网）上也有很多资料。
And we can make photocopies of our notes so everyone can have a copy.
不要填 "notes"，原文是 make photocopies OF notes，核心词是 photocopies。
关于演示辅助工具，Andy 提议把笔记制作成 photocopies（复印件）分发给每个人。
